newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EIB to lend 189 mln ecus to Belgian Belgacom.
newsitem.headline: EIB to lend 189 mln ecus to Belgian Belgacom.

text.p: The European Investment Bank (EIB) is lending 189 million ecus, or 7.5 billion francs, to Belgian telecommunications firm Belgacom, Belgian financial daily L'Echo said on Thursday.

It said the loan will go towards modernising the Belgian telecommunications network, adding that state-controlled Belgacom had set up a multi-billion franc investment programme to finance full digitilisation of its network by 2001.
The contract was signed on Wednesday in Luxembourg after several months of negotiations, it said.
L'Echo added the EIB granted a similar loan of 118 million ecus to Sweden's state-owned telecommunications group Telia AB this summer.
Belgacom is 49.9 percent owned by a consortium led by Chicago-based Ameritech. It includes Singapore Telecom, Tele Danmark and three Belgian companies.
